capability_declaration.evidence: IEEE 2030.5-2018, Section 10 (Device Capability), Section 11 (End Device Control), and Annex D (Device Capability Model)
capability_declaration.rationale: The standard explicitly defines device capabilities and allows DERs to declare their functions, but lacks full autonomy-specific declarations.

bounded_authority.evidence: IEEE 2030.5-2018, Section 11.3 (End Device Control), Section 11.7 (Demand Response Program), and Section 13 (Security)
bounded_authority.rationale: The standard defines limits on device control and authority, but lacks explicit revocation/expiry mechanisms for autonomous agents.

decision_auditability.rationale: Logging requirements are implied for security and debugging, but not explicitly for decision auditability of autonomous agents.

data_governance.rationale: Data governance is implicitly covered under security and data types, but lacks explicit consent/ownership clauses.
